resources.string: Send to a paired device. Open Ambient TV on both devices.
Send to a paired phone or another TV. Open Ambient TV on both devices. Over VPN, connect from the phone first.
No paired devices yet. Pair the two devices first.

Transfers selected accounts or network sources. Everything also includes transferable settings and menu sounds. Credentials require the option below; device settings require selection on the receiver. SmartTube and Spotify sign-ins and WireGuard keys are credentials too. WireGuard is only sent when selected: one key used on two devices at once disconnects both. Local files, VPN routing per source and pairings stay local.
Save your pending settings first. The saved configuration is transferred.
Waiting for confirmation on the receiving device.
